## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] User-visible changes include screenshots.
- [ ] ROM claims distinguish confirmed facts from inference or pending work.
- [ ] No ROM, save, credentials, personal data or unlicensed assets are included.
- [ ] Generated outputs and machine-specific paths are excluded.
